root_cause: SmartAI LoadPath makes this DB creature active, so Map::AddToActive locks its DB respawn grid. Map::UnloadAll force-unloads grids in coordinate order, ignoring normal active locks by design. It could delete spawn36 while the still-active Grif remained in37; later RemoveFromActive tried to release a lock in the already-deleted grid. Native pinned0e238cb1 regression reproduces the reported ERROR and confirms lock1 at deletion. MapInstanced DestroyInstance and DestroyGarrison call UnloadAll before deletion; Map destructor repeats it. This is map lifecycle ordering, not a pet duplication or coordinate-data repair.
repair: Drain active objects and release creature spawn locks while all grids still exist, then clear each object's active flag before the existing forced grid teardown. Session logout,120000ms pending callback drain, move-list cleanup, grid cleanup and thread-pool wait retain their order. Creature AddToActive/RemoveFromActive now change lock counts only on real membership transitions, preventing duplicate add/remove from leaking or releasing another actor's lock. Non-creatures and already-out-of-world entries are removed too. Genuine missing-grid diagnostics remain active and now correctly report current grid before spawn grid. No grid loading/respawn position/path change, NPC disabling, log-level reduction or blanket unload-error suppression.
